title: Error::MalformedIntermediate is a dead variant in pkix-path-builder
description: pkix_path_builder::Error::MalformedIntermediate is documented as reserved for future diagnostic use but no code path returns it. Pre-1.0 it can be removed freely. Post-1.0 it is locked in forever. Callers must handle a variant that can never occur. Location: /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs lines 159-173.
